resources.string: Allows Muralis to hold the screen in kiosk mode and hide the system bars.
Disabling this returns the system status and navigation bars to the dashboard.
System launcher opened; use the Muralis icon or notification to return
Automatic brightness needs the "Modify system settings" permission. Grant it to Muralis, then set the switch again.
Muralis is not the device owner, so kiosk lock-down is inactive. The dashboard works, but the screen cannot be fully locked until Muralis is provisioned as device owner.
Set Muralis as the default launcher
Open Settings and set Muralis as the Home app.
